mapper.sql: t.trip_id AS id, t.member_id, t.title, t.start_date::text AS start_date, t.end_date::text AS end_date, t.people, t.transports, t.status, (t.status = 'planned' AND t.started_at IS NOT NULL) AS archived
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_stop s WHERE s.trip_id = t.trip_id AND s.state <> 'skipped') AS stop_count FROM trip t WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.start_date DESC, t.trip_id DESC
SELECT FROM trip t WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId} AND t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM trip t WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.status = 'ongoing' AND t.trip_id <> #{tripId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip (member_id, title, start_date, end_date, people, transports) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{title}, #{startDate}::date, #{endDate}::date, #{people}, #{transports, typeHandler=com.tripbiseo.config.CsvTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip SET title = #{title}, start_date = #{startDate}::date, end_date = #{endDate}::date, people = #{people}, transports = #{transports, typeHandler=com.tripbiseo.config.CsvTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE trip_id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}

UPDATE trip SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW(), started_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ongoing' THEN NOW() ELSE started_at END, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'done' THEN NOW() ELSE finished_at END WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}
UPDATE trip SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE trip SET deleted_at = NULL WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT , to_char(t.deleted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS deleted_at FROM trip t WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.deleted_at DESC, t.trip_id DESC
SELECT , to_char(t.deleted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS deleted_at FROM trip t WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId} AND t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trip WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM trip WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.sql: stop_id AS id, trip_id, day_no AS day, place_id, name, category, address, lat, lng, start_time AS time, stay_min AS stay, fixed, move_mode AS mode, memo, state, importance, to_char(arrived_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS arrived_at, to_char(departed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS departed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trip_stop WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY day_no, start_time, stop_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_stop (trip_id, day_no, place_id, name, category, address, lat, lng, start_time, stay_min, fixed, move_mode, memo, state, importance) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{day}, #{placeId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{address}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{time}, #{stay}, #{fixed}, #{mode}, #{memo}, 'todo', #{importance})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trip_stop WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND stop_id = #{stopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_stop SET arrived_at = #{now} WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND stop_id = #{stopId} AND arrived_at IS NULL
UPDATE trip_stop SET departed_at = #{now}, state = 'done' WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND stop_id = #{stopId} AND departed_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT role, text, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS at FROM trip_chat WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY created_at, chat_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_chat (trip_id, role, text, created_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{chat.role}, #{chat.text}, COALESCE(#{chat.at, jdbcType=VARCHAR}::timestamp, NOW()))
